name: indokerja-app
description: IndoKerja.id - single-service build (backend serves the built frontend). Used for deployment platforms (Render/Railway/Heroku-like) that only expect one build + one start command.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend && node scripts/copy-frontend-build.js
